UC-1249.en: Not enough credits for a search. Add credits to keep searching.
UC-1249.note: Clauseo Case Law out of credit (the host's out_of_credit status), the same words in Settings › Connectors, the library's Case Law card and by the composer, with the figure left beside it when one was read ("7 credits left"). Replaces, by the composer, U15-64 "Out of case-law credits." and U15-65 "Searches of Indian Kanoon stop until you add more."; in Settings, U15-28 "No credits left. Case-law searches stop until you add more.". Those three are retired.

UC-1291.en: No credits. Add credits to search.
UC-1291.note: Clauseo Case Law at exactly 0 credits (out of credit, or a never-funded account the host calls signed in): Settings › Connectors, the library's Case Law card and the composer; never "Ready to search." or "Running low". Replaces the library's UC-1232 "No credits left" (retired).

UC-1460.en: Credits added. Ask again to search case law.
UC-1460.note: By the composer of a conversation whose turn ran as Clauseo Case Law went out of credit, once credits arrive (the status leaves out_of_credit); it goes when the next message is sent. Nothing resends the question. New.
